rows.44:10524:
When I came to my senses and looked ahead, Kazama and the Commander were lying there, horribly changed.
"Kazama! Hino!☆"
{f:I|I} was on the verge of tears.
Then I ran over to them.{p}
rows.44:11198:
"Don't worry. I may be an alien too, but I'm different from the Sunbararians. Truth is, I'm an Untamarian. My home, planet Untamaru, was invaded by the Sunbararians, and everyone was slaughtered. I only survived because I just happened to be off on another planet. And that planet was Earth. In the end, I got stuck living on Earth for good. I'll never forget how bitter that was. And now, by pure chance, I get to wipe out Sunbararians in a place like this. I'm really, really happy right now."
...After everything that had happened, nothing surprised me anymore.{p}
rows.44:12240:
"{a}, that's enough. Stop dancing.
You've proven splendidly that you're a Sunbararian. It's proven that you're one of the Koppeppo, a brave tribe even among the Sunbararians. I've only seen that dance once myself, but there's no doubt about it. It's a dance handed down among the Koppeppo tribe since ancient times."{p}
